تَحْزِيزٌ [see 2. ―
-b2- ] The being cut, or notched, much, or in many places; being serrated, or jagged, like the teeth of the مِنْجَل: and sometimes this is in the edges, or extremities, of the human teeth. (TA.) You say, فِى أَسْنَانِهِ تَحْزِيزٌ (S, A, K) In his teeth is a serration, and a sharpness of the extremities [such as is seen in the teeth of young persons]; syn. أُشُرٌ; (S, K;) the like of the serration of the teeth of the مِنْجَل. (A.) ―
-b3- Also The marks of cutting or notching. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
